# an exit criterion satisfied in a narrower sense than written

The spec said: "handoff scores all 5 prediction fields **with a settling ledger reference each**".
What shipped validated only the leading verdict token:

    .filter((k) => !VERDICTS.includes(scores[k].trim().split(/[\s---]/)[0].toLowerCase()))

So `likely-failure-mode: hit` -- a verdict with no reference at all -- passed the gate.
The criterion and the code agree on the word "scored" and disagree on what it means.
